definition: Core log1p O/E vectors normalized by their mean amplitude; each sample expected is its own distance-matched flank mean. All four cross-condition RMSE must exceed 1.25 times the larger within-condition RMSE; both repeat correlations >=0.5.
limitations: Descriptive shape separation, not a hypothesis test. Observed row support is not independently measured mappability. Flank means are local and can be noisy or contain structures.
